name: Waterdeep
subtitle: The City of Splendors
desc: Crown of the North. A sprawling metropolis of guildhalls, noble villas, deepwater docks, and subterranean black markets.

wards.name: Castle Ward
wards.desc: Seat of government, Mount Waterdeep, Piergeiron's Palace, and elite military suppliers.

wards.name: Sea Ward
wards.desc: Opulent noble villas, marble temples, high-magic boutiques, and master jewelers.

wards.name: North Ward
wards.desc: Quiet tree-lined avenues, wealthy merchant estates, and refined bespoke salons.

wards.name: Trades Ward
wards.desc: The beating commercial heart of the city. Guild headquarters and bustling markets.

wards.name: South Ward
wards.desc: Caravan staging grounds, teamsters, monster-hide tanners, and honest working-class shops.

wards.name: Dock Ward
wards.desc: Cramped, foggy harbor streets, maritime chandlers, rowdy taverns, and salt-worn wares.

wards.name: Field Ward
wards.desc: Unregulated muddy shantytown outside the inner walls. Cheap salvage and desperate scrap.

wards.name: City of the Dead
wards.desc: Park-like necropolis of marble mausoleums, historians, and dusk grave-keepers.

wards.name: Skullport (Port of Shadows)
wards.desc: Subterranean Underdark smuggling haven beneath Undermountain. Contraband and poisons.

wards_meta.The 50/50 Gamble Table: Gutter Flaw: Odd = Heavy wear, rusted rivet, notched blade (disadvantage on first critical). Even = Flawless bargain.
wards_meta.Rules & Roleplay Mechanics: Unregulated shantytowns, desperate barter, scrap iron, zero guild protections.
wards_meta.Meal Rules (Single Slot / Until Rest): Gritty Debuffs Only: Gutter Cramps (-2 HP per Hit Die on Short Rest), Tainted Bile (1d4 poison damage), or Nausea (Disadvantage on next Con save). Lasts until next rest.

wards_meta.The 50/50 Gamble Table: Scrap Gamble: Odd = Salt-pitted, weathered but sturdy. Even = Clean harbor salvage.
wards_meta.Rules & Roleplay Mechanics: Harbor warehouses, draft animals, salt air, sailor fences, unrefined imports.
wards_meta.Meal Rules (Single Slot / Until Rest): Harbor Debuffs Only: Harbor Cramps (-2 HP per Hit Die on Short Rest), Brine Shock (1d4 poison damage), or Queasiness (Disadvantage on next Con save). Lasts until next rest.

wards_meta.The 50/50 Gamble Table: Standard Guarantee: No gamble. Reliable guild-stamped quality and fair merchant weights.
wards_meta.Rules & Roleplay Mechanics: Licensed craft guilds, guildhall seals, standard adventuring outposts, stable prices.
wards_meta.Meal Rules (Single Slot / Until Rest): Neutral Baseline: Clean sustenance only. Satisfies daily food and water requirements with zero mechanical math.

wards_meta.The 50/50 Gamble Table: Catalogue / Minor Boon: Ordered items arrive in 24 hrs. Minor boon (free scabbard, custom fit).
wards_meta.Rules & Roleplay Mechanics: High bureaucracy, bonded warehouses, wizard colleges, palace security, luxury escorts.
wards_meta.Meal Rules (Single Slot / Until Rest): Comfortable Boons Only: Affluent Vitality (+3 to +5 Temp HP) or Restorative Hearth (+2 bonus HP per Hit Die on Short Rest). Lasts until next rest.

wards_meta.The 50/50 Gamble Table: Gala Boon: Odd = Overpriced vanity label. Even = Noble provenance, heirloom seal (+1 social checks).
wards_meta.Rules & Roleplay Mechanics: Private galleries, bespoke master crafters, noble patrons, magical wards, discrete salons.
wards_meta.Meal Rules (Single Slot / Until Rest): Aristocratic Boons Only: Gilded Vitality (+8 to +10 Temp HP) or Heroic Stamina (+3 bonus HP per Hit Die on Short Rest). Lasts until next rest.

wards_meta.The 50/50 Gamble Table: Hot Property: Odd = City Watch search risk / contraband mark. Even = Smuggled masterwork cut.
wards_meta.Rules & Roleplay Mechanics: Forbidden poisons, cursed relics, stolen guild property, secret passcodes required.
wards_meta.Meal Rules (Single Slot / Until Rest): Black Market Gambles: Caustic Surge (+5 Temp HP, but take 1d4 acid damage or Short Rest stamina penalty). Lasts until next rest.
